name: X (Twitter)
description: Post tweets, reply to tweets, and search recent tweets.

providedTools.description: Post a tweet. Pass reply_to_tweet_id (the numeric id of an existing tweet) to post it as a REPLY to that tweet instead of a standalone post — X has no separate reply endpoint, a reply is a tweet that names its parent. Same scope either way.
Search recent public tweets. Returns each tweet's id, which is what reply_to_tweet_id takes.
